description: Extract the duplicated fake-clock monkeypatch idiom in dispatch.test.ts into a shared, leak-safe test/helpers/with-fake-clock.ts helper and migrate both existing sites.

userStories.title: Extract withFakeClock helper and migrate both dispatch.test.ts sites
userStories.description: As a cam-cli maintainer, I need the duplicated Date.now + process.stderr.write fake-clock monkeypatch idiom in test/dispatch.test.ts extracted into a shared callback-style helper with guaranteed finally-restore so the pattern is reusable and leak-safe if it is ever copied.
acceptanceCriteria: A new shared helper file test/helpers/with-fake-clock.ts exports a named withFakeClock function following the existing test/helpers convention: a `// test/helpers/with-fake-clock.ts` path-banner comment on line 1, a rationale docblock, named export only, no default export. [oracle: grep -q 'export function withFakeClock' test/helpers/with-fake-clock.ts]
No default export exists in the helper. [oracle: ! grep -q 'export default' test/helpers/with-fake-clock.ts]

withFakeClock is callback-style: it saves the original Date.now and process.stderr.write, installs a fake clock (Date.now returns a mutable fakeNow starting at 0) and a chunk-capturing process.stderr.write, invokes the caller's callback with an object exposing an advance(ms) function that advances fakeNow and the captured-chunks array, and restores BOTH globals in a finally block so restoration is guaranteed even when the callback throws. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

test/dispatch.test.ts imports the helper via `import { withFakeClock } from './helpers/with-fake-clock.ts';` (relative path, explicit .ts extension per file convention). [oracle: grep -qF "from './helpers/with-fake-clock.ts'" test/dispatch.test.ts]

Both former inline fake-clock sites in test/dispatch.test.ts (the sendKeysWhenIdle default-deadline test near line 316 and the CAM-373 idle-gate exactly-once test near line 720) are migrated to withFakeClock; the inlined monkeypatch `Date.now = () => fakeNow` no longer appears anywhere in test/dispatch.test.ts. [oracle: ! grep -qF 'Date.now = () => fakeNow' test/dispatch.test.ts]

The migrated sites preserve their distinct pre-existing behavior: the default-deadline test still asserts the captured stderr contains the IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS deadline message and NOT the literal 5000 ms message; the CAM-373 idle-gate test still records sleeps via its own sleepFn (advancing the clock through the helper's advance) and still asserts send-keys fires exactly once. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A dedicated helper test test/helpers/with-fake-clock.test.ts exists and passes, proving at minimum that withFakeClock restores both Date.now and process.stderr.write even when the callback throws (the leak-safety property motivating this refactor). [oracle: bun test test/helpers/with-fake-clock.test.ts]
The dispatch test suite still passes unchanged after the refactor. [oracle: bun test test/dispatch.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: NEW test/helpers/with-fake-clock.ts, NEW test/helpers/with-fake-clock.test.ts, EDIT test/dispatch.test.ts (Site A default-deadline test ~line 316/327, Site B CAM-373 idle-gate exactly-once test ~line 720/723). Follow the existing test/helpers convention exactly (see flush-ink.ts, wait-for-condition.ts, mock-terminal-size.ts): path-banner comment line 1, rationale docblock, named export only. GOTCHA: the two sites are NOT byte-identical: Site A saves both originals contiguously and names its capture array `captured`; Site B saves originalWrite first, then does test-specific setup (events array, stderrChunks capture), then saves originalNow, names its capture array `stderrChunks`, and records sleeps in `recordedSleeps` via its own sleepFn. The finally restore block and the `Date.now = () => fakeNow` override are byte-identical at both. The helper must expose the captured-chunks array to the callback and let each caller's injected sleepFn advance the clock via advance(ms). GOTCHA: strict mode + noUncheckedIndexedAccess - guard array/chunk access. GOTCHA: test/check-test-sleeps.test.ts references test/helpers/*.ts only as synthetic string FIXTURES (around lines 52, 142); it is NOT an allowlist, the new helper needs NO registration there and contains no real sleeps. Test-only change: no production/sidecar-executed code (src/supervisor, src/tmux/dispatch.ts) and no templates/ touched, so NO coherence rebuild and NO embed-vendor check required. Do NOT change dispatch behavior or existing assertions - this is reusability + leak-safety, not a live-bug fix.
